selection_principle: Search for harmonic tension, rhythm that transforms its function, organic/electronic conflict, and temporal events; allow negative auditions and reserves.

candidates.title: Dos Pasos
candidates.role_hypothesis: piano and live processed oscillator; test organic electronic friction

audition.verdict: strong reserve — possible single quiet bridge or prelude, not structural motor
audition.listening_scope: full 4m51.8s recording, delivered in same conversation
audition.observed_structure: Spaced resonant piano notes interact with thin, pitched electronic glides and tremulous high frequencies; in the middle piano gestures become more fluid and concentrated, then decelerate into lower, widely spaced notes and reverberant fade. No sustained drum/pulse backbone and no large-scale high-pressure climax.
audition.strengths: Coherent dialogue between acoustic piano tone, electronic extension, long decay and negative space; not sentimental or formulaic.
audition.reservations: Macrodynamic arc remains contemplative and restrained; may slow a sequence that requires living rhythm and consequential harmonic struggle.
audition.place_in_possible_playlist: Single quiet hinge or threshold if supported by neighboring tracks, not opening stretch of several soft pieces; no decision to include yet.
audition.timestamp_status: qualitative full-recording audition; no claimed precise timecodes

candidates.title: voc
candidates.role_hypothesis: a voice emerges inside dark electronic space

audition.verdict: Strong reserve, potentially one dark threshold or uncanny interval before a more embodied rhythmic passage. Not yet a final inclusion.
audition.listening_scope: full recording attached to the same conversation, 4m50.5s
audition.observed_structure: An almost imperceptible low drone becomes audible beneath long, wind-like or voice-like sustained notes and distant high tonal signals. The texture gradually thickens as upper lines overlap, with piercing pitches and tremulous, choral-sounding layers. There is no stable drum-driven pulse; the dramatic vector comes from mass, register and pressure rather than rhythm. The final section disperses into distant, thinning sustained sounds.
audition.observations_boundaries: Voice resemblance is timbral; don't claim clear lyrics or confirmed instruments. Timings are approximate, not a beat-by-beat transcription.
audition.strengths: Cumulative acoustic tension and strange, layered singing/wind-like timbres create a distinct, memorable spatial transition; a real contrast with piano/electronics of Miguel Gil.
audition.reservations: Long atmosphere and no embodied rhythmic anchor; significant risk of feeling alien or physically uncomfortable to Tanya; don't stack it with more contemplative pieces or claim it will affect her the way it affected the current selection process.
audition.comparative_role: May supersede Miguel Gil Dos Pasos for a single dark transitional moment, but not both automatically. Evaluate against delivered rhythmic candidates before deciding final order.

candidates.title: Proxy
candidates.role_hypothesis: crisp rhythmic articulation and melodic deviation; risk monotonous loops

audition.verdict: Reject from playlist #33; retain in research archive as a competent but insufficiently transformative electronic groove.
audition.listening_scope: full original 3:11.65 MP3 delivered to same conversation
audition.observed_structure: Immediate springy electronic bass and dry syncopated drum grid, with short rounded upward-pitched synth calls. Layers of bright, woody clicking and fast percussive figures accumulate. Mid-to-late the density decreases and returns, and ornamental bleeps and dry attacks shift positions over a relatively constant groove; the ending thins rather than revealing a large new harmonic or formal state.
audition.strengths: Clear, surprisingly nimble rhythm and internal interlocking of short figures; a viable rhythmic motor.
audition.reservations: Little harmonic ambiguity or structural reversal; most changes add and remove timbral/percussion layers while the repeated groove retains its function. Risk of long electronic plateau, against Tanya's measured preference for shifts in meaning/pressure.
audition.contrast_with_prior_auditions: Stronger immediate physical pulse than Miguel Gil Dos Pasos or Tristán Sotomayor voc, but a weaker compelling large-scale trajectory. Reject rather than preserve another optional filler.
audition.timestamps: Broad structural observations only; no unverified precise cue points.

candidates.title: The Fractal Geometry of Nature
candidates.role_hypothesis: large-scale structure within fractal electronic texture

audition.verdict: Provisional keeper as one sharply textured motor/transformation in the middle of #33, conditional on hearing its neighbors; not a melodic heart or already approved playlist track.
audition.listening_scope: Full original 5m56.5s native in-chat music recording; listened in five consecutive chunks covering whole track.
audition.observed_structure: Quiet low background with a faint, cyclic granular pulse; quick hollow clacks and interlocking, rattling/chattering percussive figures accumulate. A sustained, busy motor develops with small metallic/high-register signals and pitch inflections; mid-recording a more diffuse low sweeping/whistling field changes the perceived function of the pulse. Clattering layers re-form, then the structure gradually strips down; near the end some isolated plucked, pitched notes become distinct and the long machine-like texture recedes.
audition.arc: Very pronounced low-level onset and growth over the first approximately 50-60 seconds; denser, sustained middle with internal textural/phase reorganization; gradually fading final minute. The center is less a chord progression than a change of rhythmic roles and spectral weight.
audition.strengths: Clear temporal direction despite fairly stable central intensity, asymmetrical interlocking percussion, distinctive material textures, memorable ending with more separable pitched figures. Stronger structural invention than Aysén Proxy.
audition.reservations: Melodic/harmonic narrative is sparse and long central swath can feel relentless or alien; not suitable as the emotional peak, and needs living/harmonically rich neighbors. Check against other auditioned rhythmic pieces, never put several unrelieved machine textures consecutively.
audition.role: one middle pivot from material/noise into rhythm and back; juxtapose with a warmer harmonic/voice or piano-based track
audition.supplemental_signal: Simple 20-second window RMS check confirms strong build (-34 dBFS first 20s to roughly -7 dBFS 60-260s) and late release (~-15 by 320s, ~-28 by 340s); numeric confirmation only, not basis of aesthetic verdict.

candidates.title: Reversa Emoción
candidates.release: La voz de la energía [pn247], 2025, track 09

audition.verdict: Provisional keeper as an embodied, darker broken-beat passage with human speech; don't finalize before comparison against Yulio.
audition.listening_scope: Full 4m05.89s original recording, in-chat audio delivered via Mira; listened sequentially in five parts (0–42, 42–90, 90–140, 140–190, 190–245.89s).
audition.observed_structure: Dark sustained electronic swell/filtered noise opening; very early heavy syncopated drums enter with grainy hiss/rubbery electronic bubbling. Rough scratch-like swishes repeatedly interrupt a strong broken-beat pattern. Around middle, fragmented low male-sounding Spanish speech becomes audible as an additional layer mixed with the restless rhythm; linguistic transcription not asserted. In latter part vocals depart and harsh rhythmic figure returns; exit dissolves to high thin waterlike/warbling electronic pitches.
audition.strengths: Striking human/industrial juxtaposition; rhythm feels physically strong and not a neutral metro-loop. Textural interruptions and retreat into a lighter end change the affective frame, making it a distinct potential segment in #33.
audition.reservations: Repetitive beat still dominates much of 4 minutes; harmonic and melodic architecture less developed than rhythmic and textural layers; intense abrasive attacks might be off-putting. Cannot assume Tanya will love it.
audition.role: Mid-arc pressurized human-machine collision; competing with Yulio's machine transformation, not automatically adjacent.
audition.compare_to_other_candidates: Much stronger presence of embodied breakbeat and voiced layer than Aysén Proxy; more muscular than Yulio but perhaps narrower in tonal development. Choose final only when all sourced audio is heard.
